note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, a number pop, three top text lines and the end card, so 6 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: I had nowhere to stay. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:09 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Sherry Wood · 68 · CASS client
mg.use: Put it on at 00:09 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:17 for 3 s, top band: I've always worked.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:17 as she says it. Hold 3 s in the top band.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop at 00:27 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: 68 years old
mg.use: Start at 00:27 so the number lands on <68 years old>. Top band.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:33 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: It's saved my life.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:33 as she says it. Top band.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: And they'll be friends for life.

mg.cue: Top text at 00:59 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: And they'll be friends for life.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:59 as she says it. Top band.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo in endcards/ yet (checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (the client asked for it on Frame.io); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After her last line at 01:06. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
